import os, re, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlparse

p = _items[0]['json']
bucket_src = p.get('bucket_src', 'mottruyen-refactored')
bucket_dst = p.get('bucket_dst', 'mottruyen-characters')
style = p.get('style', 'anime style, soft pastel colors, cinematic lighting, detailed face')
slug_filter = (p.get('slug_filter') or '').strip()
max_slugs = int(p.get('max_slugs') or 0)
overwrite = bool(p.get('overwrite') or False)

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

def s3_list(bucket, prefix='', delimiter='', token=''):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    eh = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    qs_pairs = [('list-type', '2'), ('prefix', prefix)]
    if delimiter: qs_pairs.append(('delimiter', delimiter))
    if token: qs_pairs.append(('continuation-token', token))
    qs_pairs.sort(key=lambda kv: kv[0])
    qs = '&'.join(f'{urllib.parse.quote(k, safe="")}={urllib.parse.quote(v, safe="")}' for k, v in qs_pairs)
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{eh}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'GET\n{canonical_uri}\n{qs}\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{eh}'
    cs = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    sts = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{cs}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _h(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _h(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _h(k_date, region); k_service = _h(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _h(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    sig = hmac.new(k_signing, sts.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{cs}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={sig}'
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}?{qs}', headers={'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': eh, 'Authorization': auth})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read().decode('utf-8')

slugs = []
token = ''
while True:
    xml = s3_list(bucket_src, prefix='', delimiter='/', token=token)
    for pf in re.findall(r'<Prefix>([^<]+)</Prefix>', xml):
        name = pf.rstrip('/')
        if not name or '/' in name or name.startswith('.'): continue
        slugs.append(name)
    m = re.search(r'<NextContinuationToken>([^<]+)</NextContinuationToken>', xml)
    if not m: break
    token = m.group(1)

if slug_filter:
    slugs = [s for s in slugs if s == slug_filter]
if max_slugs > 0:
    slugs = slugs[:max_slugs]

if not slugs:
    return [{'json': {'status': 'no_slugs', 'bucket_src': bucket_src}}]

return [{'json': {'slug': s, 'index': i+1, 'total': len(slugs),
                   'bucket_src': bucket_src, 'bucket_dst': bucket_dst,
                   'style': style, 'overwrite': overwrite, 'max_model_len': int(p.get('max_model_len') or 131072), 'bucket_segments': p.get('bucket_segments', 'mottruyen-character-segments'), 'manual_aliases': p.get('manual_aliases', ''), 'bucket_input': p.get('bucket_input', 'mottruyen-character-input'), 'style_anchor': p.get('style_anchor', ''), 'style_suffix': p.get('style_suffix', ''), 'negative_prompt': p.get('negative_prompt', ''), 'style_reference_image': p.get('style_reference_image', ''), 'redux_strength': p.get('redux_strength', 0.5), 'redux_strength_type': p.get('redux_strength_type', 'attn_bias'), 'redux_image_scale': p.get('redux_image_scale', 0.4), 'lora_name': p.get('lora_name', ''), 'lora_strength': p.get('lora_strength', 0.8), 'bible_filename': p.get('bible_filename', 'character_bible.md')}} for i, s in enumerate(slugs)]

import traceback
def _run(_item):
    import os, re, json, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request, time, uuid, unicodedata
    from urllib.parse import urlparse

    j = _item['json']
    slug = j.get('slug')
    if not slug:
        return {'success': False, 'error': 'no_slug'}

    bucket_src = j.get('bucket_src', 'mottruyen-refactored')
    bucket_dst = j.get('bucket_dst', 'mottruyen-characters')
    bucket_input = j.get('bucket_input', 'mottruyen-character-input')
    bible_filename = (j.get('bible_filename') or 'character_bible.md').strip()
    style = j.get('style', 'cinematic historical drama illustration, semi-realistic anime, painterly realism, mature character design')
    style_anchor = (j.get('style_anchor') or '').strip()
    style_suffix = (j.get('style_suffix') or '').strip()
    negative_prompt = (j.get('negative_prompt') or '').strip()
    style_reference_image = (j.get('style_reference_image') or '').strip()
    redux_strength = float(j.get('redux_strength') or 0.4)
    redux_strength_type = (j.get('redux_strength_type') or 'attn_bias').strip()
    redux_image_scale = float(j.get('redux_image_scale') or 0.4)
    lora_name = (j.get('lora_name') or '').strip()
    lora_strength = float(j.get('lora_strength') or 0.8)
    overwrite = bool(j.get('overwrite') or False)

    endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
    access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
    secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
    region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')
    COMFY_URL = os.environ.get('COMFY_URL', 'http://comfyui:8188')

    def _sign(method, bucket, key='', payload=b''):
        parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
        amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
        ph = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() if payload else 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
        cu = '/' + bucket + ('/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/') if key else '')
        ch = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{ph}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
        sh = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
        cr = f'{method}\n{cu}\n\n{ch}\n{sh}\n{ph}'
        cs = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
        sts = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{cs}\n{hashlib.sha256(cr.encode()).hexdigest()}'
        def _h(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        kd = _h(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp); kr = _h(kd, region); ks = _h(kr, 's3'); ki = _h(ks, 'aws4_request')
        sig = hmac.new(ki, sts.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{cs}, SignedHeaders={sh}, Signature={sig}'
        return f'{endpoint}{cu}', {'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': ph, 'Authorization': auth}

    def s3_get(bucket, key):
        url, h = _sign('GET', bucket, key)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=h), timeout=120) as r:
            return r.read()

    def s3_head(bucket, key):
        url, h = _sign('HEAD', bucket, key)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, method='HEAD', headers=h), timeout=30) as r:
                return int(r.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code in (404, 500, 503): return None
            raise
        except Exception:
            return None

    def s3_put(bucket, key, body, ctype):
        url, h = _sign('PUT', bucket, key, payload=body)
        h['Content-Type'] = ctype
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method='PUT', headers=h), timeout=180) as r:
            return r.status

    def vn_slug(s):
        s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
        s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
        s = s.replace('đ', 'd').replace('Đ', 'D').lower()
        s = re.sub(r'\s+', '-', s.strip())
        s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\-_.]', '', s)
        s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s).strip('-.')
        return s or 'unknown'

    def stable_seed(text):
        return int(hashlib.md5(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(), 16) % (2**31)

    def comfy_upload(filename, data):
        boundary = '----CF' + uuid.uuid4().hex
        head = (f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="image"; filename="{filename}"\r\n'
                f'Content-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n').encode()
        tail = (f'\r\n--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="overwrite"\r\n\r\ntrue\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n').encode()
        body = head + data + tail
        req = urllib.request.Request(f"{COMFY_URL}/upload/image", data=body, method='POST',
                                     headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return r.read()

    def render_flux(prompt_text, shot, seed, slug, cslug, sslug):
        # Match seed workflow flux1_dev_text_to_image: 1024x1024 portrait, 832x1216 halfbody.
        # KHÔNG prepend style anchor/suffix/framing — Flux nghe prompt thẳng từ bible.
        # KHÔNG negative prompt (ConditioningZeroOut như seed) → tránh conflict "child face" v.v.
        width, height = (1024, 1024) if shot == 'portrait' else (832, 1216)
        full = prompt_text  # raw, không wrap
        # Bỏ tên riêng tiếng Việt (vô nghĩa với T5/CLIP, gây nhiễu): 'of Hầu phu nhân, a female' -> 'of a female'
        full = re.sub(r'\bof\s+[^,.]+?,\s*(an?\s+(?:fe)?male)\b', r'of \1', full, flags=re.I)

        ref_uploaded = None
        if style_reference_image:
            try:
                if '/' in style_reference_image:
                    parts = style_reference_image.split('/', 1)
                    rb, rk = parts[0], parts[1]
                else:
                    rb, rk = bucket_input, style_reference_image
                ref_bytes = s3_get(rb, rk)
                ref_uploaded = f"redux_ref_{stable_seed(rk) % 100000}.png"
                comfy_upload(ref_uploaded, ref_bytes)
            except Exception:
                ref_uploaded = None

        out_name = f"{slug}/{cslug}/{sslug}_{shot}"
        wf = {
            "1": {"class_type": "UNETLoader", "inputs": {"unet_name": "flux1-dev.safetensors", "weight_dtype": "default"}},
            "2": {"class_type": "DualCLIPLoader", "inputs": {"clip_name1": "clip_l.safetensors", "clip_name2": "t5xxl_fp16.safetensors", "type": "flux", "device": "default"}},
            "3": {"class_type": "VAELoader", "inputs": {"vae_name": "ae.safetensors"}},
            "4": {"class_type": "CLIPTextEncode", "inputs": {"clip": ["2", 0], "text": full}},
            "5": {"class_type": "FluxGuidance", "inputs": {"conditioning": ["4", 0], "guidance": 3.0}},
            "6": {"class_type": "EmptyLatentImage", "inputs": {"width": width, "height": height, "batch_size": 1}},
            "7": {"class_type": "ConditioningZeroOut", "inputs": {"conditioning": ["4", 0]}},
            "8": {"class_type": "KSampler", "inputs": {"model": ["1", 0], "positive": ["5", 0], "negative": ["7", 0], "latent_image": ["6", 0], "seed": int(seed), "steps": 28, "cfg": 1.0, "sampler_name": "euler", "scheduler": "simple", "denoise": 1.0}},
            "9": {"class_type": "VAEDecode", "inputs": {"samples": ["8", 0], "vae": ["3", 0]}},
            "10": {"class_type": "SaveImage", "inputs": {"images": ["9", 0], "filename_prefix": f"characters/{out_name}"}}
        }
        if lora_name:
            wf["18"] = {"class_type": "LoraLoaderModelOnly", "inputs": {
                "model": ["1", 0], "lora_name": lora_name, "strength_model": float(lora_strength),
            }}
            wf["8"]["inputs"]["model"] = ["18", 0]
        if ref_uploaded:
            wf["12"] = {"class_type": "StyleModelLoader", "inputs": {"style_model_name": "flux1-redux-dev.safetensors"}}
            wf["13"] = {"class_type": "CLIPVisionLoader", "inputs": {"clip_name": "sigclip_vision_patch14_384.safetensors"}}
            wf["14"] = {"class_type": "LoadImage", "inputs": {"image": ref_uploaded}}
            wf["17"] = {"class_type": "ImageScaleBy", "inputs": {
                "image": ["14", 0], "upscale_method": "area", "scale_by": float(redux_image_scale),
            }}
            wf["15"] = {"class_type": "CLIPVisionEncode", "inputs": {"clip_vision": ["13", 0], "image": ["17", 0], "crop": "center"}}
            wf["16"] = {"class_type": "StyleModelApply", "inputs": {
                "conditioning": ["5", 0], "style_model": ["12", 0], "clip_vision_output": ["15", 0],
                "strength": float(redux_strength), "strength_type": redux_strength_type,
            }}
            wf["8"]["inputs"]["positive"] = ["16", 0]

        body = json.dumps({"prompt": wf, "client_id": str(uuid.uuid4())}).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(f"{COMFY_URL}/prompt", data=body, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            pid = json.loads(r.read()).get('prompt_id')
        if not pid:
            return None
        deadline = time.time() + 900
        img = None
        while time.time() < deadline:
            time.sleep(5)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{COMFY_URL}/history/{pid}", timeout=10) as r:
                h = json.loads(r.read())
            if pid in h:
                for nid, o in h[pid].get('outputs', {}).items():
                    if 'images' in o:
                        fn = o['images'][0]['filename']
                        sf = o['images'][0].get('subfolder', '')
                        u = f"{COMFY_URL}/view?filename={urllib.parse.quote(fn)}&subfolder={urllib.parse.quote(sf)}&type=output"
                        with urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=60) as rr:
                            img = rr.read()
                        break
                if img: break
        if not img: return None
        key = f"{slug}/{cslug}/{sslug}_{shot}.png"
        s3_put(bucket_dst, key, img, 'image/png')
        return key

    # ===== 1. Skip check =====
    manifest_key = f'{slug}/characters.json'
    if not overwrite:
        sz = s3_head(bucket_dst, manifest_key)
        if sz and sz > 0:
            return {'success': True, 'slug': slug, 'skipped': True, 'reason': 'manifest_exists',
                    'manifest': f'{bucket_dst}/{manifest_key}'}

    # ===== 2. Fetch character_bible.md =====
    try:
        bible = s3_get(bucket_src, f'{slug}/{bible_filename}').decode('utf-8')
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'slug': slug, 'error': f'fetch_bible_failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}',
                'hint': f'Chạy build-story-summary cho slug này trước để tạo {bible_filename}'}

    # ===== 3. Parse bible.md → character entries =====
    text = bible
    # Strip HTML comment metadata header
    text = re.sub(r'^<!--.*?-->\s*', '', text, flags=re.S)
    # Truncate at chapter section if present
    chapter_split = re.search(r'(?im)^[#>*\s]*(?:B[ƯU][ỚO]C\s*[23]\b|CHIA\s+TRUY|DI[ỄE]N\s+BI|X[ÁA]C\s*Đ[ỊI]NH.{0,30}CH[ƯU][ƠO]NG|(?:\*\*\s*)?Ch[ưu][ơo]ng\s+\d)', text)
    if chapter_split:
        text = text[:chapter_split.start()]

    # Parse danh sách nhân vật. Hỗ trợ nhiều format header mà LLM xuất ra:
    #   blockquote "> **Tên:** Name" | numbered "**1. Name**" / "### **2. Name**"
    #   bullet "*   **Name**" | old "- **Tên nhân vật**: Name"
    # Prompt nằm trong backtick: "**Prompt N (...):** `...`" (prefix >/* tuỳ ý).
    characters = []
    header_res = [
        re.compile(r'(?im)^[>\-\s]*\*\*\s*T[êe]n(?:\s*nh[âa]n\s*v[ậa]t)?\s*[:：]?\s*\*\*\s*[:：]?\s*(.+?)\s*$'),
        re.compile(r'(?im)^[#>\s]*\*\*\s*\d+\s*[.)]\s*([^*\n]+?)\*\*\s*$'),
        re.compile(r'(?im)^\s*[-*]\s+\*\*([^*\n:：]+?)\*\*\s*$'),
    ]
    markers = []
    for _rx in header_res:
        _found = list(_rx.finditer(text))
        if _found:
            markers = _found
            break
    for i, m in enumerate(markers):
        name_raw = m.group(1).strip()
        block_start = m.end()
        block_end = markers[i+1].start() if i+1 < len(markers) else len(text)
        block = text[block_start:block_end]
        block = re.split(r'\n[-=]{3,}', block, 1)[0]
        characters.append({'name_raw': name_raw, 'block': block})

    parsed = []
    for c in characters:
        name_raw = c['name_raw']
        block = c['block']
        # Strip parens for alias list
        name = re.split(r'[(（|*]', name_raw, 1)[0].strip().rstrip('–-—:')
        if not name:
            continue
        aliases = []
        for am in re.finditer(r'[(（]([^)）]+)[)）]', name_raw):
            aliases.extend([a.strip() for a in re.split(r'[,，;；/]| – | - ', am.group(1)) if a.strip()])
        # Description
        desc_m = re.search(r'\*\*[^*]*?Ngo[ạa]i\s*h[ìi]nh[^*]*\*\*\s*[:：]\s*(.+?)(?=\n\s*[\*\-]\s*\*\*|\n\s*\n|\Z)', block, re.S)
        description = (desc_m.group(1) if desc_m else '').strip()
        age_m = re.search(r'(\d{1,3}(?:-\d{1,3})?)\s*tu[ổo]i', description)
        age_range = age_m.group(1) if age_m else ''
        # Prompts (backtick required for reliable parse)
        prompts = []
        prompt_count = 0
        for pm in re.finditer(r'\*\*([^*]*?[Pp]rompt[^*]*?)\*\*[\s>]*[:：]?[\s>]*`([^`]+)`', block, re.S):
            label = pm.group(1).strip()
            p_text = pm.group(2).strip()
            # Bỏ tham số Midjourney (--ar, --style, --stylize, --v ...) — Flux không hiểu, gây nhiễu prompt
            p_text = re.sub(r'\s+--[a-zA-Z].*$', '', p_text, flags=re.S).strip()
            # Skip dummy "(giống prompt N)" / "same as prompt N"
            if re.match(r'\s*[(\[（]?\s*(?:gi[ốo]ng|same\s*as)\s*prompt\s*\d', p_text, re.I):
                continue
            prompt_count += 1
            # Stage label: text after "Prompt N – " or in parens, else 'default'
            stage_m = re.search(r'[Pp]rompt\s*\d+\s*[–\-—:]\s*(.+?)\s*$', label)
            if stage_m:
                stage_label = stage_m.group(1).strip().rstrip(':').strip()
            else:
                paren_m = re.search(r'[(（]([^)）]+)[)）]', label)
                stage_label = paren_m.group(1).strip() if paren_m else f'stage-{prompt_count}'
            prompts.append((stage_label, p_text))
        if not prompts:
            continue
        # Dedupe stage_slugs
        seen = set()
        dedup = []
        for sl, pt in prompts:
            ss = vn_slug(sl)
            base = ss; n = 1
            while ss in seen:
                n += 1; ss = f'{base}-{n}'
            seen.add(ss)
            dedup.append((sl, pt, ss))
        parsed.append({
            'name': name, 'aliases': aliases, 'description': description,
            'age_range': age_range, 'prompts': dedup,
        })
    characters = parsed

    if not characters:
        return {'success': False, 'slug': slug, 'error': 'no_characters_parsed',
                'hint': 'Markdown không có block "- **Tên nhân vật**:" hoặc không có prompt nào'}

    # ===== 4. Render Flux per character × stage =====
    manifest_chars = []
    errors = []
    for c in characters:
        name = c['name']
        cslug = vn_slug(name)
        # Seed CHỈ theo slug+name (KHÔNG theo stage) → cùng base composition/face cho trước & sau
        char_seed = stable_seed(f'{slug}|{name}')
        # Phong cách thống nhất = câu đầu của Prompt 1; prepend vào Prompt 2+ vì bible hay cắt mất anchor.
        _sm = re.match(r'\s*(.+?\.)(?:\s|$)', c['prompts'][0][1])
        style_prefix = (_sm.group(1).strip() if _sm else '')
        if len(style_prefix) < 12:
            style_prefix = style
        stages_out = []
        for si, (stage_label, prompt_text, sslug) in enumerate(c['prompts'], 1):
            # Prompt 1 đã có sẵn anchor; Prompt 2+ prepend phong cách thống nhất ở đầu.
            composed_prompt = prompt_text if si == 1 else f'{style_prefix} {prompt_text}'
            portrait_key = None; halfbody_key = None
            for shot in ('portrait', 'halfbody'):
                expected = f"{slug}/{cslug}/{sslug}_{shot}.png"
                if not overwrite and s3_head(bucket_dst, expected):
                    if shot == 'portrait': portrait_key = expected
                    else: halfbody_key = expected
                    continue
                try:
                    k = render_flux(composed_prompt, shot, char_seed, slug, cslug, sslug)
                    if k:
                        if shot == 'portrait': portrait_key = k
                        else: halfbody_key = k
                except Exception as e:
                    errors.append({'stage': 'render', 'char': name, 'stage_name': stage_label, 'shot': shot, 'error': str(e)})
            stages_out.append({
                'stage_name': stage_label,
                'stage_slug': sslug,
                'prompt': composed_prompt,
                'seed': char_seed,
                'portrait_key': portrait_key,
                'halfbody_key': halfbody_key,
            })
        manifest_chars.append({
            'name': name,
            'cslug': cslug,
            'aliases': c['aliases'],
            'age_range': c['age_range'],
            'description': c['description'],
            'stages': stages_out,
        })

    # ===== 5. Save manifest =====
    manifest = {
        'slug': slug,
        'style': style,
        'source': f'{bucket_src}/{slug}/{bible_filename}',
        'lora': lora_name,
        'characters_count': len(manifest_chars),
        'characters': manifest_chars,
        'errors': errors,
    }
    body = json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')
    try:
        s3_put(bucket_dst, manifest_key, body, 'application/json; charset=utf-8')
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'slug': slug, 'error': f's3_put_manifest_failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}'}

    return {
        'success': True, 'slug': slug,
        'manifest': f'{bucket_dst}/{manifest_key}',
        'characters_count': len(manifest_chars),
        'errors_count': len(errors),
        'errors': errors[:10],
    }

try:
    return _run(_item)
except Exception as _e:
    return {'success': False, 'error': f'{type(_e).__name__}: {_e}', 'traceback': traceback.format_exc()[:2000]}
